## Description and Rationale

I am an independent data scientist with a strong interest in aviation performance and open data. I joined the PRC Data Challenge 2026 to build an open, reproducible machine-learning model for taxi-out time prediction across the 11 European airports, to learn more about airport operations, and to contribute to open aviation research. I look forward to sharing the approach and results with the community.
